description: This file defines types and functions for managing a local shopping cart stored in browser localStorage, including adding, updating, retrieving, and clearing cart items.

methods.name: safeParseJson
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string into an object of generic type T, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: safeGet
methods.description: Retrieves the local cart JSON string from localStorage, handling exceptions.

methods.name: safeSet
methods.description: Stores a JSON string into localStorage under a specific key, handling exceptions.

methods.name: nowIso
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in ISO string format.
